name: sie
description: Open-source inference server and production cluster for all the models your agent needs.
one_liner: A self-hosted control room that runs dozens of different AI models (for search, reading PDFs, checking for unsafe content, etc.) from one place instead of juggling separate servers for each.
buyer: An engineering team building an AI product who wants to run open-source models on their own infrastructure for cost or privacy reasons instead of paying per-call to OpenAI/Anthropic APIs.
business_use_cases: A healthtech company self-hosts it to keep patient documents on their own servers while still using AI extraction models.
A vertical SaaS company cuts inference costs by running open embedding/rerank models here instead of paying a hosted API per call.
An MLOps consultancy standardizes client deployments on this stack instead of assembling a custom model-serving pipeline each time.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed/hosted deployment and tuning of the cluster for companies that want the cost savings without the ops burden.

steal_this: Deploy it on one GPU box, benchmark cost-per-1000-embeddings versus a hosted API, and pitch that number as a cost-savings audit to a company you know is burning API spend.
